categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as an Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider, offering comprehensive manufacturing services including material procurement, new product introduction (NPI), semi-finished and finished product assembly, and warehousing/logistics. Primary product categories include consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets), automotive electronics, network communications equipment, IoT devices, and new energy products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced Surface Mount Technology (SMT) with world-leading equipment capable of handling ultra-fine components (0.1mm×0.05mm) and micro ball grid array packaging. Core technologies include adhesive dispensing, electronic product manufacturing execution systems, and automated welding systems. The company operates approximately 110 industrial robots for automated assembly, testing, and packaging across the entire production line, achieving international leading standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global brands such as Huawei, Xiaomi, Honor, Samsung, and OPPO, as well as leading ODM enterprises including Huaqin Technology, Longcheer Technology, and Wentai Communications. The company serves multiple end markets: consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets), automotive electronics (serving suppliers like Valeo, Continental, Denso for brands including BMW, Audi, Volkswagen, Nissan), network communications, IoT, and new energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in mainland China (Huizhou, Shenzhen, Jiaxing), with international expansion including India (DBG Technology India), Vietnam (DBG Technology Vietnam), Bangladesh (DBG Technology BD), and Singapore. The company is expanding to Europe, Americas, and Africa through the acquisition of All Circuits S.A.S. in France. Domestic sales represent 57.07% of revenue while overseas sales account for 42.93%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the electronics supply chain. It functions as a contract manufacturer receiving materials and specifications from brand customers and ODM enterprises, performing assembly, testing, and quality control, then delivering finished products directly to customers or their designated logistics partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing intelligent manufacturing and Industry 4.0 integration; (2) expanding automotive electronics and new energy product lines; (3) global capacity expansion through overseas manufacturing bases; (4) enhancing automation and reducing labor costs; (5) developing core technologies in precision manufacturing, process optimization, and digital management systems. R&D focuses on advanced manufacturing processes, product reliability analysis, and smart production systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of electronic manufacturing services on a contract basis. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of manufactured products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a 'make-to-order' basis with customers providing specifications and materials, generating revenue through manufacturing service fees and material handling charges.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks 16th globally among EMS providers and is a leading domestic EMS enterprise in China. It competes with international EMS giants and other Chinese manufacturers. The company differentiates through superior quality control, fast response capability, advanced manufacturing technology, and established relationships with premium global brands, positioning itself in the high-end segment of the EMS market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale manufacturer with 2024 revenue of RMB 6.88 billion (27.38% growth from 2023's RMB 5.40 billion). Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was RMB 275.67 million in 2024 (down 30.52% from 2023's RMB 396.74 million). Total assets reached RMB 8.22 billion at year-end 2024. The company demonstrates strong revenue growth but experienced profit margin compression in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes: (1) superior quality management with multiple certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO13485, ISO45001); (2) rapid response capability through fast NPI, short production cycles, and quick logistics; (3) advanced manufacturing technology and automation; (4) global manufacturing network providing localized services; (5) long-term stable partnerships with premium customers; (6) comprehensive one-stop service from design to logistics; (7) proven track record serving world-leading brands with high reliability and on-time delivery.
